title: 墨爾本地鐵隧道計畫~Melbourne Metro Tunnel project
focus: 新建都市鐵路隧道接網與全線整合~New urban rail tunnel network integration and service transition
summary: 以墨爾本地鐵隧道從建設到接入營運網路的背景，建立新站、隧道及既有郊區鐵路協同運轉的教學案例。學徒把施工沉陷、試驗紀錄、進路切換及轉乘時間相連，分開首次載客與完整班表整合兩個系統狀態。~Use the Melbourne Metro Tunnel’s transition from construction to network operation to construct a teaching case joining new stations and tunnels to suburban railways. Link construction movement, test records, route switching and transfer time. Treat the first passenger opening and full timetable integration as distinct system states with different acceptance and operating evidence.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 work_length=551 m；單元 2 得 residual=5.091414 mm；單元 3 得 gradient=0.63 mm/m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 setup 的擾動測試，結果改為 532.1 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以墨爾本地鐵隧道從建設到接入營運網路的背景，建立新站、隧道及既有郊區鐵路協同運轉的教學案例。學徒把施工沉陷、試驗紀錄、進路切換及轉乘時間相連，分開首次載客與完整班表整合兩個系統狀態。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives work_length=551 m; unit 2 gives residual=5.091414 mm; unit 3 gives gradient=0.63 mm/m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing setup in the first unit changes its result to 532.1 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Melbourne Metro Tunnel’s transition from construction to network operation to construct a teaching case joining new stations and tunnels to suburban railways. Link construction movement, test records, route switching and transfer time. Treat the first passenger opening and full timetable integration as distinct system states with different acceptance and operating evidence. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2015 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道展開早期現地調查工作；2025 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道於十一月開放旅客服務；2026 年：二月班表轉換將地鐵隧道整合進完整營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以墨爾本地鐵隧道從建設到接入營運網路的背景，建立新站、隧道及既有郊區鐵路協同運轉的教學案例。學徒把施工沉陷、試驗紀錄、進路切換及轉乘時間相連，分開首次載客與完整班表整合兩個系統狀態。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2015: Early site investigations for Melbourne Metro Tunnel began; 2025: Melbourne Metro Tunnel opened to passengers in November; 2026: The February timetable change integrated Metro Tunnel into full operations. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Melbourne Metro Tunnel’s transition from construction to network operation to construct a teaching case joining new stations and tunnels to suburban railways. Link construction movement, test records, route switching and transfer time. Treat the first passenger opening and full timetable integration as distinct system states with different acceptance and operating evidence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.mechanism: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把接網施工窗口與全線班表轉換視為不同的交接事件。~A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Treat the connection possession and the complete timetable transition as separate handover events.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 51.975 min，其餘固定，結果為 532.1 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 51.975 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 532.1 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.
units.verify: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。~Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.
units.failure: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。~Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.
units.misconception: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量~The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
units.practice: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.mechanism: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。 兩座標差的歐氏長度表示平面殘差大小，不是隨機標準差。先把兩套座標轉到相同基準和單位，再檢查各方向偏差；共同平移可能讓相對殘差很小但絕對位置仍錯。 以固定外部基準重複測量，區分儀器誤差和真實位移。~The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results. Network closure and an external datum are needed to reveal systematic bias that agreement alone can conceal. The Euclidean length of two coordinate differences measures planar residual, not random standard deviation. Transform both coordinate sets to one datum and unit before inspecting directional differences. Common translation can leave a small relative residual while absolute position remains wrong. Repeat surveys against a fixed external datum to separate instrument error from real movement.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00315 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.091414 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.003465 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.292091 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00315 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.091414 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.003465 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.292091 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded.
units.verify: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。~Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias.
units.failure: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 閉合良好仍可能全部同向漂移，須使用外部穩定基準。~One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Good closure can coexist with common drift; an external stable reference remains necessary.
units.misconception: 兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確~Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
units.practice: 加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 對街區及既有鐵路分別畫出沉陷剖面和坡折尺度。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Plot settlement profiles and kink length scales separately for city blocks and existing tracks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.01386 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.693 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.0126 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.63 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.01386 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.693 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.title: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.mechanism: 填充空隙所需漿量先由幾何空隙體積估算，再考慮損失與材料體積變化。注入量大不代表填充完整，因為漿液可能沿裂縫流失；壓力、流量與返漿紀錄必須互相對照。 此算例把空隙視為長乘寬乘均勻厚度的薄層，再乘假定餘量。它不是完整圓環幾何；若用於環隙局部展開，須說明薄層近似，且不能由注入總量推論填充均勻。 以假想隧道局部薄層空隙驗算注漿體積，保留超灌和漏失項。~Required grout begins with geometric void volume and allowances for loss and volume change. A large injected volume does not prove complete filling because grout can escape through cracks. Pressure, flow and returns must be interpreted together to distinguish filling from loss. This example treats a void as length times width times uniform thickness with an assumed allowance. It is not full annular geometry. A locally unwrapped annulus requires an explicit thin-layer approximation, and total injection does not establish uniform filling. Check grout volume for a hypothetical local thin tunnel void, retaining excess and loss terms.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.042 m; allowance=1.15 1；計算：grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.415 m^3。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0462 m，其餘固定，結果為 2.6565 m^3。模型邊界：均勻幾何間隙與假設損失係數；不指定注漿壓力或現地工法。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.042 m; allowance=1.15 1; calculation: grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.415 m^3. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0462 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2.6565 m^3. Model boundary: Uniform geometric gap and assumed loss allowance; no injection pressure or field procedure is specified.
units.verify: 核對批次體積、流量計及返漿量，將注入壓力與時間曲線同步，完成後以獨立檢測確認空隙分布。 校對泵送流量計與漿液批次密度，分開累計注入、回流及廢棄量，核對薄層幾何尺寸。~Reconcile batch volume, flow meter and returns, synchronise injection pressure over time, and verify void distribution afterward using an independent inspection method. Calibrate pump flow and batch density, separately total injection, return and waste volumes, and verify the thin-layer dimensions.
units.failure: 漏失會讓注入體積增加而空隙仍未填滿，局部封堵又會使壓力快速上升；僅憑達到預算漿量不能驗收。 達到預算漿量不等於填滿空隙，須查回流和漏失。~Loss can increase injected volume while leaving a void unfilled, and local blockage can raise pressure rapidly; reaching the budgeted volume is not acceptance evidence. Reaching the budgeted grout volume does not prove void filling; inspect returns and losses.
units.misconception: 注入漿量超過幾何空隙體積就能證明沒有殘留空洞~Injecting more than the geometric void volume proves that no void remains.
units.practice: 比較正常填充與沿裂縫漏失兩組流量壓力紀錄，做體積收支並提出能辨識兩者的獨立檢測。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 grout_volume，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare flow-pressure records for normal filling and crack leakage, build a volume balance, and propose an independent inspection that distinguishes the two. Also recalculate grout_volume for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對新隧道與既有線進路切換建立互鎖狀態和拒絕條件。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Construct interlocking states and refusal conditions for route switching between new tunnel and existing lines.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 在資料更新前後檢查列車位置參考和版本一致性。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Check train-position references and version consistency before and after data updates.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.2 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.805721 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.62 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.835401 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.2 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.805721 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.62 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.835401 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 將接續區段的目標速度和定位誤差帶入保護距離。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Include target speed and localisation uncertainty in protective distance at the connecting section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=25.2 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=411.5692 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 27.72 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 514.1526 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=25.2 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=411.5692 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.72 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 514.1526 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 比較新站開放前後的旅客步行與垂直轉乘路徑。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Compare walking and vertical-transfer paths before and after the new stations open.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=189 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=66 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 207.9 m，其餘固定，結果為 47.1 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=189 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=66 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 207.9 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 47.1 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 分開一般換氣與隧道活塞風的量測邊界，避免重複計量。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Separate normal-ventilation and piston-airflow measurement boundaries to avoid double counting.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=263.1526 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.875 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 239.2296 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=263.1526 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.875 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 239.2296 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 將初期載客與完整班表的故障暴露時間分別統計。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Calculate failure exposure separately for initial passenger service and the complete timetable.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
